title: Generic maximal Seshadri constants in positive characteristic
exact_target: Over any algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, for a smooth projective geometrically integral n-fold X with $n\geq 3$ and ample L, does some $r_{0}(X,L)$ guarantee $\varepsilon (L;x_{1},\dots ,x_r)=(L^n/r)^{1/n}$ at the geometric generic ordered tuple for every $r\geq r_{0}$?
